# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go to the `main` branch and the latest release.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Report it privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/security/advisories/new). You get an answer in the advisory thread, and the fix ships with a published advisory.

For how the recipe handles credentials and remote access, see [docs/security.md](docs/security.md).
